def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] in (1, 2)]
    r1, c1, _ = next(p for p in points if p[2] == 1)
    r2, c2, _ = next(p for p in points if p[2] == 2)
    dr = 1 if r2 > r1 else -1 if r2 < r1 else 0
    dc = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1 if c2 < c1 else 0
    nr = max(0, min(abs(r2-r1), abs(c2-c1)) - 1)
    r, c = r1, c1
    for _ in range(nr):
        r += dr; c += dc
        if (r, c) != (r2, c2): out[r][c] = 3
    while r != r2:
        r += dr
        if (r, c) != (r2, c2): out[r][c] = 3
    while c != c2:
        c += dc
        if (r, c) != (r2, c2): out[r][c] = 3
    return out
